chunks.text: "Excluded Claims" means claims arising from data loss or regulatory fines. Excluded Claims are carved out of the scope of the limitation of liability in Section 2.2 and are not released, waived, or discharged by any provision of this Agreement.
Limitation of Liability. Each party's total aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed two million five hundred thousand dollars ($2,500,000).
Payment. Customer shall pay all undisputed invoices within sixty (60) days of receipt. Customer hereby waives and releases and discharges any right to withhold payment of undisputed amounts.
Notwithstanding Section 2.2, the liability cap set forth in this Section 4.1 shall control with respect to any claim brought under the Security Addendum.
Notwithstanding Section 2.4, the payment schedule set forth in this Section 5.1 shall control for all Statements of Work executed after the Effective Date.
Notwithstanding Section 2.2, Customer shall have no claim against Provider in respect of any Excluded Claims, and the limitation in Section 2.2 shall be read accordingly.
